title: Workspaces
description: Organize your products, teams and projects in separate workspaces.
create_description: Each workspace keeps its data and tool access separate.
name: Workspace name
empty_description: Start with a workspace to bring your projects and tools together.
scope_description: Manage this workspace’s name and access. Teams and projects belong to this workspace.
unavailable_description: You may not have access, or the connection failed. Choose another workspace from the list or try again.
credentials_description: Create separate, expiring access for each tool. Revoking one credential does not disconnect your other tools.
credentials_load_error: Tool access could not be loaded.
credentials_empty_description: Create workspace-specific access to connect your API or MCP client.
token_description: This key is shown only now. Once you close this window, you cannot view it again.
copy_error: Could not copy to clipboard. Select the key and copy it manually.
credential_description: Choose a recognizable tool name and grant only the access it needs.
revoke_description: “{{name}}” will no longer have access to this workspace. You can create new access if needed.
empty_readonly_description: Once the installation owner creates a workspace, workspaces you can access will appear here.
